name: Test Execution
description: Activates the `testing` tool group, runs EditMode tests, then PlayMode tests, and aggregates the results into a structured report.
toolGroupNotes: `run_tests` and `get_test_job` are in the `testing` tool group, which is OFF by default -- only `core` is enabled. The activate-testing step below must run first. The MCP client may need a refresh or reconnect before the newly activated tools appear. `read_console` is `core` and needs no activation.

steps.name: Activate the `testing` tool group (run_tests/get_test_job are off by default)
Start EditMode tests (returns job_id; poll separately with get_test_job)
Start PlayMode tests (returns job_id; poll separately with get_test_job)
Aggregate test results from console output
